    dest = episode_path(recipe_dir, task, ep)
    data = episode_path(view_root, task, ep)
    early, late = "s0/sg.gz", "s1/sg.gz"
    paths = [early, late, "task_entities.json", "language.json"]
    for name in paths:
        path = data / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(name)
    files = {name: digest(data / name) for name in paths}
    manifest = data / "episode_manifest.json"
    atomic_write_json(manifest, {"files": files, "states": [{"state_id": 0, "frame": 0, "scene_graph": early}, {"state_id": 1, "frame": 10, "scene_graph": late}]})
    original, invented = "Pick it up.", "Task: Pick it up. Future state added."
    record = {
        "schema": "g2_initial_language_record_review_v1", "recipe": recipe.to_dict(),
        "initial_frame": 0, "episode_index": ep, "task_class": task,
        "original_instruction": original, "augmented_instruction": invented,
        "training_ready": False,
        "provenance": {
            "g1_source_binding_digest": source_binding, "initial_scene_graph_relative_path": late,
            "view_manifest_sha256": digest(manifest), "initial_scene_graph_sha256": files[late],
            "task_entities_sha256": files["task_entities.json"], "legacy_language_sha256": files["language.json"]
        },
        "text_id": canonical({"original_instruction": original, "augmented_instruction": invented, "recipe_id": recipe.recipe_id}),
    }
    atomic_write_json(root / "OUTPUT_IDENTITY.json", {"schema": "g2_independent_language_root_v2", "source_binding_digest": source_binding, "training_ready": False})
    atomic_write_json(recipe_dir / "RECIPE.json", {"schema": "g2_initial_language_recipe_declaration_v1", "source_binding_digest": source_binding, "training_ready": False, "recipe": recipe.to_dict()})
    atomic_write_json(dest / "initial_context.json", record)
    atomic_write_json(dest / "COMPLETE.json", {"schema": "g2_initial_language_complete_review_v1", "complete": True, "recipe_id": recipe.recipe_id, "training_ready": False, "text_id": record["text_id"], "content_sha256": digest(dest / "initial_context.json")})
    try:
        value = read_versioned_initial_language(root, recipe_id=recipe.recipe_id, task_class=task, episode_index=ep, source_binding_digest=source_binding, original_instruction=original, view_root=view_root)
        assert value == record
        print("self-consistent later-SG CAP2: ACCEPTED")
    except InitialLanguageError as exc:
        print("self-consistent later-SG CAP2: REJECTED", str(exc))
